6282d80.title: Search, screen time, widgets and Home Assistant
notes: **Problem report.** The phone companion’s TV settings tab downloads a report of crashes and errors to attach to a bug report. It stays on the TV until you download it and holds no settings or passwords. If the page stops, Shore now reloads it instead of closing.
**What’s new.** After Shore updates itself, Home shows what changed once. You can read it again under Settings › Google TV › Shore updates.

**Widgets.** An optional row of cards under the clock (Settings › Clock › Widgets): the forecast for the next three days, your next three events, and with Home Assistant the inside temperature, lights on and any open door or window.
**Italiano e Türkçe.** Shore and the phone companion now speak Italian and Turkish, with ANSA, la Repubblica, BBC News Türkçe and DW Türkçe as news sources.

**Type from your phone.** The companion’s new Keyboard tab types on the TV: into Shore’s Search right away, and into other apps’ text fields once you turn on Shore phone keyboard in the TV’s Accessibility settings.
**Search.** All apps has a Search button: type with the remote’s arrows or a keyboard to find apps, HDMI inputs and Settings pages. On a keyboard, just start typing on Home.
**Screen time.** Give an app a daily limit, from 30 minutes to 3 hours (Settings › Google TV › Parental lock › Screen time). When it runs out Shore comes back, and the PIN gives 30 more minutes.
New Settings › Add-ons. Add-ons stay out of sight until you switch them on.

Home Assistant add-on: see your rooms, switch lights, switches and fans, lock and unlock, and watch cameras live from a Smart home button on Home. Built by [mozthewah](https://github.com/mozthewah), thank you!
Connect Home Assistant from the phone companion; the access token stays on the TV and out of backups.
With Home Assistant on, the line under the clock shows the temperature and humidity inside.

39e9db2.title: Mix your wallpaper sources
notes: **Pick as many sources as you like.** Shore’s own wallpapers, your photos, NASA, Bing, Wikimedia and Picsum can all rotate together, and only the ones you tick are used.
**See what’s rotating.** The sources page counts the photos in the mix, and the wallpaper gallery marks every photo that isn’t.
**Clear buttons.** OK on a source says *Add to rotation* or *Remove from rotation*.
**Honest about outages.** If a source can’t be reached, Shore names it and tries again later.
**On your phone too.** The companion picks sources the same way.
Long photo titles no longer run into the preview.

2b71be0.title: The big one: your icons, a parental lock, a sleep timer and your calendar
notes: Parental lock (Settings › Google TV › Parental lock): a four-digit PIN before the apps you choose open, and before Settings, Apps on Home and Quick actions if you like. Type it with the number keys or pick each digit with the arrows.
Sleep timer (Settings › Night): 30, 60, 90 or 120 minutes, then the TV switches off, even while another app is open. The time left shows under the clock.
Calendar under the clock: paste your calendar's iCal address in the phone companion and the next event appears, like "Tomorrow 9:30 · Dentist". Repeating events are understood.
Music view: Up next shows the next three songs when the music app shares its queue.
Music view: Translate lyrics (off by default) puts a translation into the TV's language under every synced line, using Google Translate.
The screensaver no longer starts over the music view while a song is playing.
